eligibility_rule: evidence-safe AND product-representable AND policy-approved AND not already canonical AND not conflicting. Each conjunct is measured separately below so a row excluded for one reason cannot be reported as excluded for another.

nodes.why_fewer_than_rows: 1166 rows produce 1132 nodes because 34 print units were staged once per covered verse. Importing a node per row would create the duplicated 1:1 translations the owner forbade.

relationships.note: one edge per node, anchored on one verse. A range node deliberately does not create an edge from every verse it covers: the span lives in covers_canonical_keys, and edges from all of them would make the range indistinguishable from 68 dedicated translations.

owner_decisions_applied.OWNER_DECISION_A_RV_SPAN: CLOSE. No rows are imported for RV 1.65-1.70: M13 already resolved the span, and the 30 paired verses are covered by its MANTRA_RANGE nodes, which the product now represents.

LATIN_SUBSTITUTION_POLICY.discrepancy_note: The owner decision quotes 22, which is what Gate C measured. Two more rows carry Latin literals and were classified as source-explicit English: AV 20.136.1 and RV 10.61.6. Both are verified against the pinned source pages and both are imported as Latin, because the decision's operative clause is that a Latin row must never increase English coverage.

properties.text: Ye who move active in your strength like Gods with Asuras' magic powers, Even as the monkey scorns the dogs, Bandages! scorn the Kābava.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Agni as soon as he was born made ready the sacrifice and was the Gods' preceder. May the Gods eat our offering consecrated according to this true Priest's voice and guidance.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Brought forth in olden time, the everlasting, high over all that is was she, the Ancient. The mighty Goddess of the Morn, refulgent with one eye, looketh round with one that winketh,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thee, Indra, we invoke, the Bull, what time the Soma hath been pressed. Drink of the sweetly-flavoured juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The best of guardian hath the man within whose dwelling-place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let us serve Agni with our hyms, Sage who consumeth ox and cow, Who beareth Soma on his back.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let the Maruts drink Trishtups from the Potar's cup, according to the season Soma from heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let Agni from the Kindler's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let Indra the Brāhman from the Brāhman's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let the God, Granter of Wealth, from the Potar's cup drink Trishtups, according to the season Soma from heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee: O Indra, drink this Soma here. Seat thee on this my sacred grass.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let both thy bay steeds, yoked by prayer long-maned, O Indra, bring thee nigh.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We Soma-bearing Brāhmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, who have pressed the juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come unto us who poured the juice, come hither to our eulogies. Drink of the juice, O fair of face.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it run. Take with thy tongue the pleasant drink.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice. Sweet be the Soma to thy heart.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Like women, let this Soma juice invested with its raiment, glide.. Most active Indra, close to thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Mighty in bulk, strong-necked, stout-armed in the wild rapture. of the juice Doth Indra smite the foemen dead.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, advance, go forward thou who by thy might art Lord of all. Slay, Vritra-slayer slay thy foes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest treasure unto- him Who pours the juice and worships thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred. grass. Run hither, come and drink thereof.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well! this juice is shed for thy delight: Thou art invoked, Ākhandala!
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To Kundapāyya, grandson's son, grandson of Sringavrish, to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thee, Indra, we invoke, the Bull, what time the Soma is ex- pressed. So drink thou of the savoury juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, whom many laud, accept the strength-confering Soma juice. Quaff, pour down drink that satisfies.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, with all the Gods promote our wealth-bestowing sacrifice, Thou highly-lauded Lord of men.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Lord of the brave, to thee proceed these drops of Soma juice expressed, The bright drops to thy dwelling-place.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Within thy belly, Indra take Soma the juice most excellent: The heavenly drops belong to thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Drink our libation, Lord of hymns: with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Our glory, Indra, is thy gift.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To Indra go the treasures of the worshipper which never fail: He drinks the Soma and is strong.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: From far away, from near at hand, O Vritra-slayer, come to us: Accept the songs we sing to thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: When from the space between the near and far thou art invoked by us, Thence, Indra. come thou hitherward.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.
properties.reuse_basis: Griffith's kanda-20 print omits this verse. Its canonical Sanskrit is SURFACE-IDENTICAL to VG:RV:SAK:M03:S040:V009 -- accent-stripped, script-folded comparison of this graph's own two text versions, similarity 1.0 -- and the graph asserts EXACT_PARALLEL_OF. Griffith's attributed Rigveda translation of that verse is therefore a published translation of exactly this text. Both keys: VG:AV:SAU:K20:S006:V009 and VG:RV:SAK:M03:S040:V009. This is cross-corpus reuse of a Rigveda translation, not a translation of the Atharvaveda.

properties.text: Sūrya, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man:
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and ninety castles down, Slew Vritra and smote Ahi dead.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream Riches in horses, kine, and corn.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, whom many laud, accept the strength-conferring Soma juice. Quaff, pour down drink that satisfies.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Drink as of old, and let the draught delight thee: hear thou my prayer and let our songs exalt thee. Make the Sun visible, make food abundant: slaughter the foes,. pierce through and free the cattle.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come to us; they have called thee Soma-lover. Here is the pressed juice: drink thereof for rapture. Widely-capacious, pour it down within thee, and invocated hear us like a father.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Full is his chalice. Blessing! Like a pourer I have filled up the vessel for his drinking. Presented on the right, dear Soma juices have brought us Indra,. to rejoice him, hither.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, moun- tain-like, in precious things Him swift we seek for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: I crave of thee that hero strength, that thou mayst first regard this prayer, Wherewith thou helpest Bhrigu and the Yatis and Praskanva when the prize was staked.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea, that, Indra, is. thy hero strength. For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds. have called aloud.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise as- cend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth and give unfailing aid.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The Bhrigus are like suns, like Kanvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent to win. The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Fort-render, Lord of Wealth, dispelling foemen, Indra with lightnings hath o'ercome the Dāsa. Impelled by prayer and waxen great in body, he hath filled earth and heaven, the bounteous Giver.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: I stimulate this zeal, the Strong, the Hero, decking my song of praise for thee Immortal. O Indra, thou art equally the leader of heavenly hosts and human generations.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Leading his band Indra encompassed Vritra; weak grew the wily leader enchanters. He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyansa, and made the milch-kine of nights apparent.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, light-winner, days' creator, conquered, as guardian, hostile bands with those who loved him. For man the days' bright ensign he illumined, and found the light for his great joy and gladness.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Forward to fiercely falling blows pressed Indra, hero-like doing many hero exploits. Those holy songs he taught the bard who praised him, and widely spread these Dawns' resplendent colour.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: They laud the mighty acts of him the mighty, the many glorious deeds performed by Indra. He in his strength, with all-surpassing prowess, through wond- rous arts crushed the malignant Dasyus.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Lord of the brave, Indra who rules the people gave freedom to the Gods by might and battle. Wise singers glorify with chanted praises these his achievements in Vivasvān's dwelling.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Excellent, conqueror, the victory-giver, the winner of the light and godlike waters, He who hath won this broad earth and this heaven,—in Indra they rejoice who love devotions.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He gained possession of the Sun and horses; Indra obtained the cow who feedeth many. Treasure of gold he won; he smote the Dasyus and gave protec- tion to the race of Aryas.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He took the plants and days for his possession; he gained the forest trees and air's mid-region. Vala he cleft, and chased away opponents: thus was he tamer of the overweening.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered, The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vritras, wins and gathers treasures.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Prayers have been offered up through love of glory: Vasishtha, honour Indra in the battle. He who with might extends through all existence hears words which I, his faithful servant, utter.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: A cry was raised which reached the Gods, O Indra, a cry to them to send us strength in combat. None among men knows his own life's duration: bear us in safety over these our troubles.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The Bays, the booty-seeking car I harness: my prayers have reached him who accepts them gladly. Indra, when he had slain resistless Vritras, forced with his might the two world-halves asunder.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: the singers sought thy holy rite, O Indra. Come unto us as with his team comes Vāyu: thou, through our solemn hymns, bestowest booty.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: So may these gladdening draughts rejoice thee, Indra, the Mighty, very bounteous to the singer. Alone among the Gods thou pitiest mortals: O Hero, make thee glad at this libation.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thus the Vasishthas glorify with praises Indra, the Mighty One, whose arm wields thunder. Praised, may he guard our wealth in kine and heroes. Ye Gods,. preserve us evermore with blessings.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Impetuous, Thunderer, strong, quelling the mighty, King, potent, Vritra-slayer, Soma-drinker, May he come hither with his yoked bay horses. May Indra glad- den him at noon libation.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Lords of great wealth, Brihaspati and Indra, rejoicing at this sacrifice drink Soma. Let the abundant drops sink deep within you: vouchsafe us riches with full store of heroes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let your swift-gliding coursers bear you hitherward with their fleet pinions. Come ye forward with your arms. Sit on the grass; a wide seat hath been made for you: delight yourselves, O Maruts, in the pleasant food.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For Jātavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car. For good in his assembly is this care of ours. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With these, borne on one car, Agni, approach us; or borne on many, for thy steeds are able. Bring, with their Dames, the Gods, the Three-and-Thirty, after thy Godlike nature, and he joyful.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We call on thee, O peerless One. We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee wonderful in fight.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gone forth. We, therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, free- giver, as our guardian God.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help:
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Borne by bay steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes delight. The Bounteous Lord bestows on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him most liberal, lofty Lord of lofty wealth, verily powerful and strong, I bring my hymn, Whose checkless bounty, as of waters down a slope, is spread abroad for all that live, to give them strength.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Now all this world, for worship, shall come after thee—the offerer's libations like descending floods, When the well-loved one seems to rest upon the hill, the thun- derbolt of Indra, shatterer wrought of gold.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him the terrible, most worthy of high praise, like radiant Dawn, bring gifts with reverence in this rite, Whose being, for renown, yea, Indra-power and light, have been created, like bay steeds, to move with speed.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thine, Indra, praised by many excellently rich! are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee. Lover of praise, none else but thou receives our laud: as Earth loves all her creatures, love thou this our hymn.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Great is thy power, O Indra, we are thine. Fulfil, O Maghavan, the wish of this thy worshipper. After thee lofty heaven hath measured out its strength to thee and to thy power this earth hath bowed itself.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, who hast thunder for thy weapon, with thy bolt hast shattered into pieces this broad massive cloud. Thou hast sent down obstructed floods that they may flow: thou hast, thine own for ever, all victorious might.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Like birds who keep their watch, plashing in water, like the loud voices of the thundering rain-cloud, Like merry streamlets bursting from the mountain thus to Brihaspati our hymns have sounded.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The son of Angiras, meeting the cattle, as Bhaga, brought in Aryaman among us. As Friend of men he decks the wife and husband. As for the race, Brihaspati, nerve our coursers.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Brihaspati, having won them from the mountains, strewed down, like barley out of winnowing-baskets, The vigorous, wandering cows who aid the pious, desired of all, of blameless form, well-coloured.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As the Sun dews with meath the seat of Order, and casts a flam- ing meteor down from heaven, So from the rock Brihaspati forced the cattle, and cleft the earth's skin as it were with water.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Forth from mid-air with light he draye the darkness, as the gale blows a lily from the river. Like the wind grasping at the cloud of Vala, Brihaspati gathered to himself the cattle.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Brihaspati, when he with fiery lightnings cleft through the weapon of reviling Vala, Consumed him as tongues eat what teeth have compassed: he threw the prisons of the red cows open.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: That secret name borne by the lowing cattle within the cave Brihaspati discovered, And draye, himself, the bright kine from the mountain, like a bird's young after the eggs' disclosure.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He looked around on rock-imprisoned sweetness as one who eyes a fish in scanty water. Brihaspati, cleaving through with varied clamour, brought it forth like a bowl from out the timber.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He found the light of heaven, and fire, and Morning: with lucid rays he forced apart the darkness. As from a joint, Brihaspati took the marrow of Vala as he gloried in his cattle.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As trees for foliage robbed by winter, Vala mourned for the cows Brihaspati had taken. He did a deed ne'er done, ne'er to be equalled, whereby the sun and moon ascend alternate.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Like a dark steed adorned with pearl, the Fathers have decorat- ed heaven with constellations. They set the light in day, in night the darkness, Brihaspati cleft the rock and found the cattle.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: This homage have we offered to the Cloud-God who thunders out to many in succession. May this Brihaspati vouchsafe us fulness of life with kine and horses, men, and heroes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Directed unto thee my spirit never strays, for I have set my hopes on thee, O much-invoked! Sit, wonderful! as King upon the sacred grass, and let thy drinking-place be by the Soma juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: From indigence and hunger Indra turns away: Maghavan hath dominion over precious wealth. These the Seven Rivers flowing on their downward path increase the vital vigour of the Mighty Steer.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As on the fair-leafed tree rest birds, to Indra flow the gladden- ing Soma juices that the bowls contain. Their face that glows with splendour through their mighty power hath found the shine of heaven for man, the Aryas' light.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As in the game a gambler piles his winnings, so Maghavan, sweeping all together, gained the Sun. This mighty deed of thine none other could achieve, none, Maghavan, before thee, none in recent time.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Maghavan came by turns to all the tribes of men: the Steer took notice of the people's songs of praise. The man in whose libations Sakra hath delight by means of potent Somas vanquisheth his foes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As waters flow together to the river, thus Somas to Indra flow, as rivulets to the lake. In place of sacrifice sages exalt his might, as the rain swells the corn by moisture sent from heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He rushes through the region like a furious bull, he who hath made these floods the dames of worthy lords. This Maghavan hath found light for the man who brings oblation, sheds the juice, and promptly pours his gifts.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let the keen axe come forth together with the light: here be, as erst, the teeming cow of sacrifice. Let the Red God shine pure with his refulgent ray, and let the Lord of heroes glow like heaven's clear sheen.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle. May we allied, as first in rank, with princes, obtain possessions by our own exertion.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Brihaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners. May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Ye twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Brihaspati, and thou, O Indra. Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends, The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy: On thy laud only have I thought.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep: Incessantly they punish sloth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Faithful to thee we loudly sing, heroic Indra, songs to thee. Mark, gracious Lord, this act of ours.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Give us not up to man's reproach, to foeman's hateful calumny: In thee alone is all my strength.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou art mine ample coat of mail, my champion, Vritra-slayes, thou. With thee for Friend I brave the foe.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Indra, for the strength that slays the foe and conquers in the fight We turn thee hitherward to us.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, may those who praise thee hitherward. Direct thy spirit and thine eye.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, with all our songs we invocate. Thy names for triumph over foes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We strive for glory through the powers immense of him whom many praise, Of Indra who supports mankind.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For the foe's slaughter I address Indra whom many invocate, To win us booty in the wars.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: In battles be victorious. We seek thee, Lord of Hundred Powers, O Indra, that the foe may fall.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: In splendid combats of the hosts, in glories where the fight is won, Indra, be victor over foes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Drink thou the Soma for our help, bright, vigilant, exceeding strong, O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Satakratu, powers which thou mid the Five Races hast dis- played These, Indra, do I claim of thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, great glory hast thou gained. Win splendid fame which none may mar: We make thy might perpetual.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come to us either from anear, or, Sakra, come from far away. Indra, wherever be thy home, come to us thence, O Thunder- armed.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Verily Indra, conquering all, driveth even mighty fear away; For firm is he and swift to act.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra be gracious unto us: sin shall not reach us afterward . And good shall be before us still,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: From all the regions of the world let Indra send security. The foe-subduer, swift to act.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We will present fair praise unto the Mighty One, our hymns to Indra in Vivasvān's dwelling-place; For he hath ne'er found wealth in those who seem to sleep; those who give wealth to men accept no paltry praise.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Giver of horses, Indra, giver, thou, of kine, giver of barley, thou art Lord and guard of wealth: Man's helper from of old, not disappointing hope, Friend of our friends, to thee as such we sing this praise.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, most splendid, powerful, rich in mighty deeds, this treasure spread around is known to be thine own. Gather therefrom. O Conqueror, and bring to us: fail not the hope of him who loves and sings to thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Well-pleased with these bright flames and with these Soma drops, take thou away our poverty with steeds and kine. With Indra scattering the Dasyu through these drops, freed from their hate may we obtain abundant food.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let us obtain, O Indra, plenteous wealth and food, with strength exceeding glorious, shining to the sky. May we obtain the Goddess Providence, the strength of heroes, special source of cattle, rich in steeds.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: These our libations, strength inspiring Soma draughts, gladdened thee in the fight with Vritra, Hero-Lord, What time thou slewest for the singer with trimmed grass ten thousand Vritras, thou resistless in thy might.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou goest on from fight to fight intrepidly, destroying castle after castle here with strength; Thou Indra, with thy friend who makes the foe bow down, slewest from far away the guileful Namuchi.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou hast stuck down in death Karanja, Parnaya, in Atithigva's very glorious going forth: Unyielding, when Rijisvan compassed them with siege, thou hast destroyed the hundred towns of Vangrida.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With all-outstripping chariot wheel, O Indra, thou far-famed, hast overthrown the twice ten kings of men, With sixty thousand nine-and-ninety followers, who came in arms to fight with friendless Susravas.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou hast protected Susravas with succour, and Tūrvayāna with thine aid, O Indra: Thou madest Kutsa, Atithigva, Ayu subject unto this king, the young, the mighty.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: May we protected by the Gods hereafter remain thy very pro- sperous friends, O Indra. Thee we extol, enjoying through thy favour life-long and joyful and with store of heroes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Hero, the Soma being pressed I pour the juice for thee to drink Sate thee and finish thy carouse.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Let not the fools, or those who mock, beguile thee when they seek thine aid: Love not the enemies of prayer.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Here let them with rich milky draught cheer thee to great munificence: Drink as the wild bull drinks the lake.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra, the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Hither his bay steeds have been sent, red steeds are on the sacred grass. Where we in concert sing our songs.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For Indra, Thunder-armed, the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Invoked to drink the Soma juice come with thy bay steeds, Thunder-armed! Come, Indra, hitherward, to me.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Our priest is seated true to time; the grass is regularly strewn; The pressing-stones were set at morn.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: These prayers, O thou who bearest prayer, are offered. Seat thee on the grass. Hero, enjoy the offered cake.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Vritra-slayer, be thou pleased with these libations, with these hymns, Song-loving Indra, with our lauds.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Our hymns caress the Lord of Strength, vast, drinker of the Soma's juice, Indra, as mother-cows their calf.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Delight thee with the juice we pour for thine own great munificence: Yield not thy singer to reproach.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We, Indra, dearly loving thee, bearing oblation, sing thee hymns: Thou, Vasu, nearly lovest us.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O thou to whom thy Bays are dear, loose not thy horses far from us: Here glad thee, Indra, Lord Divine.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: May long-maned courses, dropping oil, bring thee on swift car hitherward. Indra, to seat thee on the grass.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come to the juice that we have pressed, to Soma, Indra! blent with milk: Come, favouring us, thy bay-drawn car!
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come, Indra, to this gladdening drink, placed on the grass, pressed out with stones: Wilt thou not drink thy fill thereof?
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To Indra have my songs of praise gone forth, thus rapidly sent hence, To turn him to the Soma-draught.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Hither with songs of praise we call Indra to drink the Soma. juice: Will he not come to us by lauds?
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, these Somas are expressed, Take them within thy belly, Lord Of Hundred Powers, thou Prince of wealth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We know thee winner of the spoil and resolute in battles, Sage! Therefore thy blessing we implore.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Borne hither by thy stallions, drink, Indra, this juice which we have pressed, Mingled with barley and with milk.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, for thee in thine own place I urge the Soma for thy draught: Deep in thy heart let it remain.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We call on thee, the Ancient One, Indra, to drink the Soma juice, We Kusikas who seek thine aid.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, the mortal man well guarded by thine aid goes foremost in the wealth of horses and of kine. With amplest wealth thou fillest him, as round about the waters clearly seen afar fill Sindhu full.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The heavenly waters come not nigh the priestly bowl: they but look down and see how far mid-air is spread: The Deities conduct the pious man to them: like suitors they delight in him who loveth prayer.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Praiseworthy blessing hast thou laid upon the pair who with uplifted ladle serve thee, man and wife. Unchecked he dwells and prospers in thy law: thy power brings blessing to the sacrificer pouring gifts.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: First the Angirases won themselves vital power, whose fires were kindled through good deeds and sacrifice. The men together found the Pani's hoarded wealth, the cattle, and the wealth in horses and in kine,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Atharvan first by sacrifices laid the path; then, guardian of the Law, sprang up the loving Sun. Usanā Kāvya drove the kine hither with him: let us with offer- ings honour Yama's deathless birth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: When sacred grass is trimmed to aid the auspicious work, or the hymn makes its voice of praise sound to the sky, Where the stone rings as 'twere a singer skilled in laud,—Indra in truth delights when these come near to him.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee the Bull, O thou whom bay steeds carry. Here take delight. O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us Indra the mightiest of all.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, And all that strengthens, to our call.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: I call him, mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy steed: The lights are shining in the sky.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: On both sides of the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the thief.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O Men! where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single sovran of all wealth. My worshipper should be rich in kine.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: I should be fain, O Lord of Might, to strengthen and enrich the sage, Were I the lord of herds of kine,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow. Yielding in plenty kine and steeds.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence, The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth and made Himself a diaden in heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great. Hast won all treasures for thine own.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light. When he cleft Vala limb from limb.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Showing the hidden he draye forth the cows for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured. Firm and immovable in their place.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods. Bright shine the drops that gladden thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify: Thou blessest those who worship thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.
properties.reuse_basis: Griffith's kanda-20 print omits this verse. Its canonical Sanskrit is SURFACE-IDENTICAL to VG:RV:SAK:M08:S014:V011 -- accent-stripped, script-folded comparison of this graph's own two text versions, similarity 1.0 -- and the graph asserts EXACT_PARALLEL_OF. Griffith's attributed Rigveda translation of that verse is therefore a published translation of exactly this text. Both keys: VG:AV:SAU:K20:S029:V001 and VG:RV:SAK:M08:S014:V011. This is cross-corpus reuse of a Rigveda translation, not a translation of the Atharvaveda.

properties.text: Bay horses with their long manes bring Indra to drink the Soma juice, The Bountiful to our sacrifice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The Dasyus, when they fain would climb by magic arts and mount to heaven, Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side Their band who poured no gifts to thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: In the great synod will I laud thy two bay steeds: I prize the sweet strong drink of thee the Warrior-God, His who pours lovely oil as'twere with yellow drops. Let my songs enter thee whose form hath golden tints.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Ye who—in concert sing unto the gold-hued place, like bay steeds driving onward to the heavenly seat, For Indra laud ye strength allied with tawny steeds, laud him whom cows content as'twere with yellow drops.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: His is that thunderbolt, of iron, golden-hued, gold-coloured, very dear, and yellow in his arms; Bright with strong teeth, destroying with its tawny rage. In Indra are set fast all forms of golden hue.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As if a lovely ray were laid upon the sky, the golden thunder- bolt spread out as in a race. That iron bolt with yellow jaw smote Ahi down. A thousand flames had he who bore the tawny-hued.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, thou, when praised by men who sacrificed of old, hadst pleasure in their lauds, O Indra golden-haired. All that befits thy song of praise thou welcomest, the perfect: pleasant gift, O golden-hued from birth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: These two dear Bays bring hither Indra on his car, thunder- armed, joyous, meet for laud, to drink his fill. Many libations flow for him who loveth them: to Indra have: the gold-hued Soma juices run.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The gold-hued drops have flowed to gratify his wish: the yellow. drops have urged the swift Bays to the Strong. He who speeds on with bay steeds even as he lists hath satisfied his longing for the golden drops.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: At the swift draught the Soma-drinker waxed in might, the iron. One with yellow beard and golden hair, He, Lord of tawny coursers. Lord of fleet-foot mares, will bear his bay steeds safely over all distress.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: His yellow-coloured jaws, like ladles, move apart, what time,. for strength, he makes the yellow-tinted stir, When. while the bowl stands there, he grooms his tawny steeds, when he hath drunk strong drink, the sweet juice that he: loves.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Yea, to the dear one's seat in homes of heaven and earth the- bay steeds' Lord hath whinnied like a horse for food. Then the great wish hath seized upon him mightily, and the beloved One hath gained high power of life.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, comprehending with thy might the earth and heaven, acceptest the dear hymn for ever new and new. O Asura, disclose thou and make visible the Cow's beloved home to the bright golden Sun.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Indra, let the eager wishes of the folk bring thee the golden- jawed, delightful, on thy car. That, pleased with sacrifice wherein ten fingers toil, thou mayest at the feast drink of our offered mead.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Juices aforetime, Lord of Bays, thou drankest, and thine, and only thine, is this libation. Gladden thee, Indra, with the mead-rich Soma: pour it down ever, Mighty One, within thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Drink of the juice which men have washed in waters and fill the- full, O Lord of tawny horses. O Indra, hearer of the laud, with Soma which stones have mix- ed for thee enhance thy rapture.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee the Bull, O thou whom bay steeds carry. Here take delight, O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O mighty Indra, through thine aid, thy prowess, obtaining life, zealous, and skilled in worship. Men in the house who share the sacred banquet stand singing praise that brings them store of children.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He who just born, chief God of lofty spirit, by power and might became the God's protector, Before whose breath, through greatness of his valour, the two worlds trembled, He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He who fixed fast and firm the earth that staggered, and set at rest the agitated mountains, Who measured out air's wider middle region and gave the heaven support, He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Who slew the Dragon, freed the Seven Rivers, and draye the kine forth from the cave of Vala, Begat the fire between both stones, the spoiler in warrior's battle, He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: By whom this universe was made to tremble, who chased away the humbled brood of demon, Who, like a gambler gathering his winnings, seized the foe's riches, He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Of whom, the terrible, they ask, Where is He? or verily they say of him, He is not. He wastes the foeman's wealth like stakes of gamblers. Have faith in him for He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Stirrer to action of the poor and lowly, of priest, of suppliant who sings his praises Who, fair-faced, favours him who presseth Soma with stones adjusted, He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He under whose supreme control are horses, all chariots, and the hamlets, and the cattle: He who begat the Sun, begat the Morning, leader of waters. He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To whom both armies cry in close encounter, foe against foe, the stronger and the weaker; Whom two invoke upon one chariot mounted, each for himself, He, O ye men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He, without whom men conquer not in battle, whom, warring, they invoke for help and succour; He, all this universe's type and image, who shakes what never shook, He, men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He who hath smitten, ere they know their danger, with his hurl- ed weapon many grievous sinners: Who pardons not his boldness who provokes him, who slays the Dasyu, He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He who discovered in the fortieth autumn Sambara dwelling in the midst of mountains: Who slew the Dragon putting forth his vigour, the demon lying there, He, men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Who drank the juice poured at the seas of Order, subduing Sambara by superior prowess, Who hoarded food within the mountain's hollow wherein he grew in strength, He, men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Who, with seven guiding reins, the Bull, the mighty, set the Seven Rivers free to flow at pleasure; Who, thunder-armed, rent Rauhina in pieces when scaling heaven, He, O ye men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Heaven, even, and the earth bow down before him, before his very breath the mountains tremble. Known as the Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, the wielder of the bolt, He, men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Who aids with favour him who pours the Soma, and him who brews it, sacrificer, singer; Whose strength our prayer and offered Soma heighten, and this our gift, He, O ye men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Born, manifested in his Parents' bosom, He knoweth as a son the Highest Father. He who with vigorous energy assisted the companies of Gods, He, men, is Indra
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Lord of Bay steeds, who loves the flowing Soma, He before whom all living creatures tremble. He who smote Sambara and slaughtered Sushna, He the Sole Hero, He, O men, is Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou verily art true strong God who sendest wealth to the man who brews and pours libation. So may we evermore, thy friends, O Indra, address the synod with brave sons about us.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him, to him swift, strong, and high-exalted, I bring my song of praise as dainty viands; My thought to him resistless, meet for praises, prayers offered most devotedly to Indra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him I offer praise as choice refreshment, bring forth my song, with seemly laud besiege him. For Indra, Lord of olden time, the singers shall deck their hymns with heart and mind and spirit.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him then with my lips my song of praises, excellent, winning heavenly light, I offer, To magnify with hymns of invocation and eulogies the Lord, most bounteous Giver.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Even for him I frame a laud—so fashions the wright a chariot for the man who needs it Songs for wise Indra hymned with invocation, a song composed with care and all-impelling.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: So with my tongue I deck, to please that Indra, my hymn as't- were a horse, through love of glory, To reverence the Hero, bounteous Giver, famed far and wide, destroyer of the castles.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Even for him hath Tvashtar forged the thunder, most deftly wrought, celestial, for the battle. Wherewith he reached the vital parts of Vritra, striking—the vast, the mighty—with the striker,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As soon as, at libations of his mother, great Vishnu had drunk up the draught, he plundered. The dainty cates, the cooked mess; but One stronger transfixed the wild boar, shooting through the mountain.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him, to Indra when he slew the Dragon, the Dames too, Consorts of the Gods, wove praises. The mighty heaven and earth hath he encompassed: thy great- ness heaven and earth, combined, exceed not.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Yea, of a truth, his magnitude surpasseth the magnitude of earth, mid-air and heaven. Indra whom all men praise, the Sovran Ruler, waxed in his home loud-voiced and strong for battle.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Through his own strength with bolt of thunder Indra smote piece-meal Vritra, drier up of waters. He let the floods go free, like cows imprisoned, for glory, with a heart inclined to bounty.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Through his resplendent power still stood the rivers when with his bolt on every side he stayed them. With lordly might favouring him who worshipped, he made a ford, victorious, for Turviti.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Vast, with thine ample power, with eager movement against this Vritra cast thy bolt of thunder. Rend thou his joints, as of an ox dissevered, with bolt oblique that floods of rain may follow.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Sing with new lauds his exploits wrought aforetime, the deeds of him, yea, him who moveth swiftly, When, hurling forth his weapons in the battle, he with impetuous wrath lays low the foemen.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: When he, yea, he is born the firm-set mountains and the whole heaven and earth tremble in terror. May Nodhas ever lauding the protection of this dear Friend win straightway strength heroic.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Now unto him of these things hath been given what he, who rules alone o'er much, electeth. Indra helped Etasa, the Soma presser, contending in the chariot- race with Sūrya.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thus to thee, Indra, yoker of bay coursers, the Gotamas have brought their prayers and praises. Bestow upon them thought, decked with all beauty. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With these my hymns I glorify that Indra who is alone to be invoked by mortals. The Lord, the Mighty One, of manly vigour, victorious, Hero, true, and full of wisdom.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Our ancient sires, Navagvas, sages seven, while urging him to show his might, extolled him, Dweller on heights, swift smiting down opponents, guileless in word, and in his thoughts most mighty.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We seek that Indra to obtain his riches that yield much food, and men, and store of heroes. O Lord of Bay Steeds, bring to make us joyful, celestial wealth abundant, undecaying.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Declare to us—if at thy hand aforetime the earlier singers have obtained good fortune What is thy share and portion, strong Subduer, Asura-slayer, rich, invoked of many?
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He who for car-borne, thunder-wielding Indra, hath a hymn, craving deeply-piercing, fluent, Who sends a song effectual, firmly-grasping, and strength- bestowing, he comes near the mighty.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Strong of thyself! thou with this art hast shattered with thought- swift Parvata, him who waxed against thee; And, Mightiest! rager! boldly rent in pieces things that were firmly fixed and never shaken..
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Him will we fit for you with new devotion, the strongest, Ancient One, in ancient manner. So way that Indra, boundless, faithful leader, conduct us o'er all places hard to traverse.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou for the people who oppress hast kindled the earthly firma- ment and that of heaven. With heat, O Bull, on every side consume them heat earth and flood for him who hates devotion:
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Of all the heavenly folk, of earthly creatures, thou art the King, O God of splendid aspect. In thy right hand, O Indra, grasp the thunder: Eternal! thou destroyest all enchantments.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Give us confirmed prosperity, O Indra, vast and exhaustless for the foes' subduing. Strengthen therewith the Arya's hate and Dāsa's; and let the arms of Nahushas be mighty.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come with thy teams which bring all blessings, hither, disposer, much-invoked, exceeding holy! Come to me swiftly with these teams of coursers, these which no fiend, no God may stay or hinder.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He, like a bull with sharpened horns, terrific, singly excites and agitates all the people. Then givest him who largely pours libation his wealth who pours not, for his own possession.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou verily, Indra, gavest help to Kutsa, willingly lending ear to him in battle. When, aiding Arjunneya, thou subduedst to him both Kuyava and the Dāsa Sushna.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Bold One, thou with all thine aids hast boldly helped Sudās whose offerings were accepted, Pūru in winning land and slaying foemen, and Trasadasyu son of Purukutsa.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: At the Gods' banquet, Hero-souled! with heroes, Lord of Bay Steeds, thou slewest many Vritras. Thou sentest in swift death to sleep the Dasyu, both Chumuri and Dhuni, for Dabhiti,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: These were thy mighty powers that, Thunder-wielder! then swiftly crushedst nine-and ninety castles. Thou capturedst the hundredth in thine onslaught; thou slewest Namuchi, thou slewest Vritra.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Old are the blessings, Indra, which thou gavest Sudās the wor- shipperwho brought oblations. For thee, the strong I yoke thy strong bay horses: let them, approach our prayers and wealth, Most Mighty!
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Give us not up, Lord of Bay Horses, victor, in this our time of- trouble, to the wicked. Deliver us with true and faithful succour: dear may we be to thee among the princes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: May we men, Bounteous Lord, the friends thou lovest, near i thee be joyful under thy protection. Fain to fulfil the wish of Atithigva, bow Turvasa, bow down,. the son of Yadu.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Swiftly, in truth, O Bounteous Lord, about thee men skilled im hymning sing their songs and praises. Elect us shares of their love and friendship who by their calls on, thee despoiled the niggards.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thine are these Lauds, O manliest of heroes, Lauds which revert to us and give us riches. Favour these, Indra, when they strike the foemen, as Friend and Hero and the heroes' helper.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Now, lauded for thine aid, heroic Indra, sped by our prayer,, wax mighty in thy body. To us apportion wealth and habitations. Ye Gods, protect us- evermore with blessings.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee. O Indra, drink the Soma here. Sit thou on this my sacred grass.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward. Give ear and listen to our prayers.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We, Soma-bearing Brāhmans, call thee, Soma-drinker, with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing juice expressed.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked: car, Indra, the golden, Thunder-armed.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra hath raised the Sun aloft in heaven that he may see afar. He burst the mountain for the kine.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For you, from every side, we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others,’ let him be.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light. When he cleft Vala limb from limb.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Showing the hidden cows he draye them forth for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured, Firm and immovable from their place.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of waters: bright. Have shone the drops that gladden thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous: equal in your sheen.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With Indra's well-beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial name.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With bones of Dadhyach for his arms, Indra, resistless in attack, Struck nine-and-ninety Vritras dead,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He, searching for the horse's head, removed among the moun- tains, found At Saryanāvān what he sought.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Then verily they recognized the essential form of Tvashtar's Bull. Here in the mansion of the Moon.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: From Indra have I measured an eight-footed and nine-cornered. song, Delicate, faithful to the Law.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar, What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Arising in thy might thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed The Soma poured into the bowls.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long;
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Indra, that which is concealed in firm strong place precipitous: Bring us the wealth for which we long:
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Great riches which the world of men shall recognize as sent by thee: Bring us the wealth for which we long,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, great Sovran of man- kind, the Chief Most liberal who controlleth men.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96
