properties.text: In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs, Like the flood's longing for the sea.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight, Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as the dove turneth to his mate. Thou carest too for this our prayer.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and pleasantness Be his who signs the laud to thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight: In others too let us agree.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Him who advances men to wealth, sends light to lead them in their wars, And quells their foemen in the fray:
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship Safely beyond all enemies.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As such, O Indra, honour us with wealth and treasure: further us, And lead us to felicity.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We make this Indra show his strength, to strike the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous Hero shall he be.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra was made for giving, most powerful, friendly in carouse, Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: By song, as 'twere, the mighty bolt, which none may parry, was prepared: Lofty, invincible he grew.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed: The lights are shining in the sky.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: They yoke on both sides to the car the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O Men r where no form was, Wast born together with the Dawns,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that= is, Sūrya, that every one may see.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The constellations pass away, like thieves, together with their- beams, Before the all-beholding Sun.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o'er the world of men, Like fiery flames that burn and blaze.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Swift and all-beautiful art thou, O Sūrya, maker of the light. Illuming all the radiant realm.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou guest to the troops of Gods, thou comest hither to man- kind, Hither, all light for us to see.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou with that eye of thine wherewith thou seest, brilliant. Varuna, The active one throughout mankind.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Pervadest heaven and wide mid-air, melting the days out with. thy beams, Sun, seeing all things that have birth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Seven bay steeds, harnessed to thy car, bear thee, O.thou far- seeing One, God, Sūrya, thee with radiant hair.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Sūrya hath yoked the seven bright mares, the daughters of the car: With these, His own dear team, he travelleth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The swiftly-moving songs of praise pour on thee streams of vital strength As mother cows refresh the calf.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Swift move the bright ones while they blend the Milk with vital vigour, as A dame her infant with her heart.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Fair hymns bring glory to the Strong, and Indra-vigour; unto, me Fatness and milk and length of days.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: This brindled Bull hath come and sat before the Mother in the east, Advancing to the Father Heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As expiration from breath she moves along the lucid spheres: The Bull shines forth through all the sky.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Song is bestowed upon the Bird. It reigns supreme throughout thirty realms Throughout the days at break of morn.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: When voices, fain to win mid-air, ascended to the Mighty One, The vigorous God was filled with joy.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Praise with the voice the Mighty, praise the awful with the voice: in heaven He, the most bounteous, hath been glad.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Praise with the voice the Mighty: he rules in each realm. In transport he Hath set upon the sacred grass.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As cows low to their calf in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delightful juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Celestial, bounteous Giver, God, with power and might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things. Him soon we see for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: I crave of thee that hero strength—that thou mayst first regard this prayer Wherewith thou helpest Bhrigu and the Yatis and Praskanva when the prize was staked.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea—Indra, that manly strength of thine. For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have cried aloud.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: What newest of imploring hymns shall, then, the zealous mortal sing? For have not they who laud his might and Indra-power won for themselves the light of heaven?
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: When shall they keep the Law and praise thee mid the Gods? Who counts as Rishi and as sage? When wilt thou ever, Indra, Bounteous Lord, come nigh to presser's or to praiser's call?
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; Praise of the Bounteous Lord who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As with a hundred hosts he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes. As from a mountain flow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Sakra I praise, for victory, far-famed, exceeding bountiful. Who gives, as 'twere in thousands, precious wealth to him who sheds the juice and worships him.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Arrows with hundred points, unconquerable, are this Indra's mighty arms in war. He streams on liberal worshippers like a hill with springs, when juices poured have gladdened him.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream thy worshipper round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Men, Vasu! by the Soma, with lauds call thee to the foremost place. When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As a wild elephant rushes on, this way and that way, mad with heat. None may restrain thee; yet come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: When he, the mighty, ne'er o'erthrown, stedfast, made ready for the fight. When Indra, Bounteous Lord, lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh, Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice, The Lord of Light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with help he gives.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The holy sages form a ring, looking and singing to the Ram. Your very bright inciters, void of all deceit, are with the chan- ters nigh to hear.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Oft, oft I call that Indra, Maghavan the mighty, who evermore possesses power, ever resistless. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, and, thunder armed, make all our pathways pleasant for us.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, what joys as Lord of Light thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The wasteless share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured. Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, foe-slayer, hath been raised to joy and power by the men. Him, verily, we invocate in battles whether great or small: be he our aid in fights for spoil.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For, Hero, thou art like a host, art giver of abundant prey. Strengthening even the feeble, thou aidest the sacrificer, thou givest the worshipper ample wealth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: When war and battles are on foot, booty is laid before the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly rushing Bays. Whom wilt thou slay and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He, righteous-hearted, at each time of rapture gives us herds of kine. Gather in both thy hands for us treasures of many hundred sorts. Sharpen thou us, and bring us wealth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Refresh thee, Hero, with the juice outpoured for bounty and for strength. We know thee Lord of ample store, to thee have sent our heart's desires: be therefore our protector thou.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: These people, Indra, keep for thee all that is worthy of thy choice. Discover thou, as Lord, the wealth of men who offer up no gifts: bring thou to us this wealth of theirs.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds. To our assistance day by day.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma, Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Drink for our help the Soma bright, vigilant, and exceeding strong, O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Satakratu, powers which thou mid the Five Races hast dis- played, These, Indra, do I claim of thee.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, great glory hast thou gained. Win splendid fame which none may mar. We make thy might perpetual.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come to us either from anear, or, Sakra, come from far away. Indra, wherever be thy home, come thence, O Caster of the Stone.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Verily Indra, conquering all, driveth even mighty fear away. For firm is he and swift to act.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra be gracious unto us: sin shall not reach us afterward, And good shall be before us still.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: From all the regions of the world let Indra send security. The foe-subduer, swift to act.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-checked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Boldly, bold Hero, bring us spoil in thousands for the Kanvas' sake. O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellow-hued with store of kine.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none. Good are the gifts which Indra gives. He is not wroth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to granting boons.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Verily, Sūrya, thou art great; truly, Āditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed thy greatness is admired: yea, verily, great art thou, O God.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Yea, Sūrya, thou art great in fame: thou evermore, O God, art great. By greatness thou art President of Gods, divine, far-spread, inviolable light.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: His portion is exceeding great, like a victorious soldier's spoil. Him who is Indra, Lord of Bays, no foes subdue. He gives the Soma-pourer strength.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Make for the holy Gods a hymn that is not mean, but well arranged and fair in form. Full many snares and bonds subdue not him who dwells with Indra through his sacrifice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For so thou art the hero's Friend, a Warrior too art thou, and strong: So may thy heart be won to us.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: So hath the offering; wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers: So dwell thou, Indra, even with me.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Be not thou, like a slothful priest, O Lord of wealth and spoil: rejoice. In the pressed Soma blent with milk.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: So also is his excellence, great copious, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: So are his lovely gifts: let laud be said and praise to Indra sung. That he may drink the Soma juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone, gives room and shine like gold.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Āyu and for Manu's sake: Now joying in!!this sacred grass thou beamest forth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: This day to singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this, might of thine. Win thou the waters, day by day, thralls of the strong.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Sing forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud: Invite the potent Indra with your songs of praise;
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Whose lofty might—for doubly strong is he—supports the heaven and earth. And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Such, praised by many! thou art King: alone thou smitest foe- men dead, To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: WE call on thee, O Matchless One! We seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee wonderful in fight
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gonse forth. We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, free-giver, as our Guardian God.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: Borne by Bay Steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes; delight. May Maghavan bestow on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: To Indra sing a Sāman, sing to the high Sage a lofty song, To him who keeps the Law, inspired and fain for praise.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, Indra, art preeminent: thou gavest splendour to the Sun. Maker of all things, thou art mighty and All-God.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realms: of heaven. The Gods, O Indra, strove to win thee for their friend.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Sing forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud: Invite the potent Indra with your songs of praise;
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Whose lofty might—for doubly strong is he—supports the heaven and earth, And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Such, praised by many! thou art King. Alone thou smitest foe- men dead, To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We will, with Indra, and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing. worlds into subjection. Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring, let Indra form to- gether with the Ādityas.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With the Ādityas with the band of Maruts, may Indra be pro- tector of our bodies; As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras,. keeping safe their godlike nature,
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked! about them on their vigorous God-head. With this may we obtain strength God-appointed, and brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He who alone bestoweth might on mortal man who offereth gifts, The ruler of resistless power, is Indra, sure.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: When will he trample like a weed the man who hath no gift for him? When verily will Indra hear our songs of praise?
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: He who with Soma juice prepared among the many harbours. thee, Verily Indra gains thereby tremendous might.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Joy, mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma draughts, wherewith Thou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we pray.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Wherewith thou helpest Adhrigu, the great Dasagva, and the God Who stirs the sunlight, and Sea, for that we pray.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floods. To go the way ordained by Law, for that we pray.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable, Vast as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds. Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For thou art, he, O Indra, who stormest all castles of the foe, Slayer of Dasyus, man's supporter, Lord of heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most. So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra whom tawny coursers bear, praise such a thine,. preeminent None by his power or by his goodness hath attained
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and' might. Who must be glorified by constant sacrifice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends! the Hero who deserves the laud, Him who with none to aid o'ercomes all tribes of men.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, celestial God, Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than mead.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne'er may be surpassed, Whose liberality, like light, is over all.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As Vyasva did, praise Indra, praise the strong unfluctuating guide. Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Now, son of Vyasva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new. The very wise, whom living men must glorify.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou knowest, Indra, thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive Powers, As one secure from pitfalls each succeeding day.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: The pourer of oblations gains the home of wealth pouring his gift conciliates hostilities, yea, the hostilities of Gods. Pouring he strives, unchecked and strong, to win him riches thousandfold. Indra gives lasting wealth to him who pours forth gifts; yea, wealth he gives that long shall last.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Ne'er may those manly deeds of yours for us grow old, never may your bright glories fall into decay, never before your time decay. What deed of yours, new every age, wondrous, surpassing man,. rings forth, Whatever, Maruts may be difficult to gain grant us whate'er is hard to win.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: I think on Agni, Hotar, the munificent, the gracious Son of strength, who knoweth all that live, as holy Sage who knoweth all. Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods. He, when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longeth for it with his glow.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Busied with sacrifice, with spotted deer and spears, gleaming. upon your way with ornaments, yea, our friends, Sitting on sacred grass, ye sons of Bharata, drink Soma from the Potar's bowl, O Men of heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Bring the Gods hither, Sage, and offer sacrifice. At the three altars seat thee willingly .O Priest. Accept for thy delight the proffered Soma mead: drink from the Kindler's bowl and sate thee with thy share.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: This is the strengthener of thy body's manly might: strength,. victory for all time are laid within thine arms. Pressed for thee, Maghavan, it is offered unto thee: drink from the chalice of this Brāhman, drink thy fill.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Him whom of old I called on, him I call on now. He is to be invoked: his name is He who Gives. Here brought by priests in Soma mead. Granter of Wealth, drink Soma with the Seasons from the Hotar's Cup.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds, To our assistance day by day.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song, Him who is better than thy friends.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place, Ye who serve Indra and none else;
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest, Still may we dwell in Indra's care.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice. That to the Friend gives wings and joy.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, Satakratu, drankest this and wast the Vritras' slayer; thou. Helpest the warrior in the fray.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: We strengthen, Satakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerfull in fight, That, Indra, we may win us wealth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt Friend of him who pours the juice, Yea, to this Indra sing your song.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent, Indra, with Soma juice outpoured.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth: With riches may he come to us;
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not: To him, to Indra, sing your song.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these bright drops, The Somas mingled with the curd.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice, strong Indra, for preeminence.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee: May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Lord of Hundred Powers, our chants of praise and lauds have strengthened thee: So strengthen thee the songs we sing!
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, whose succour never fails, accept this treasure thousand- fold, Wherein all manly powers abide.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep. Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes urborn, Taking their sacrificial name.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm, Foundest the kine even in the cave.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth, The far-renowned, the mighty One.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Then, faring on by Indra's side, the fearless, let thyself be seen,. Both gracious and in splendour peers.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With Indra's well-beloved hosts, the blameless, tending heaven- ward, The sacrificer cries aloud.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Come from this place, O wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven! Our songs of praise all yearn for this.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Or Indra we implore for help from here, from heaven above the earth, Or from the spacious firmament.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, Thunder-armed.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra hath raisedjthe Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful One.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: In mighty battle we invoke, Indra, Indra in lesser fight, The friend who bends his bolt at fiends.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud, For us, thou irresistible.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's, praises rise: I find no laud worthy of him.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might, The ruler irresistible:
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race. Of those who dwell upon the earth.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others', may he be.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquer- ing wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid;
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand. By thee assisted with the car.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Aided by thee, the Thunder-armed, Indra; may we lit up the bolt, And conquer all our foes in fight.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: With thee, O Indra, for ally, with missile-darting heroes may We conquer our embattled foes.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Mighty is Indra, yea, supreme; greatness becomes the Thunderer! Wide as the heaven extends his power;
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: Which aideth those to win them sons who come as heroes to the fight, Or singers loving holy thoughts.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: His belly drinking deepest draughts of Soma like an ocean swells, Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Atharvaveda, E. J. Lazarus, Benares, 1895-96

properties.text: So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.

properties.text: So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung, That he may drink the Soma juice.
properties.work_edition: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Hymns of the Rigveda, 2nd ed.
